featured_reviews.name: Ajit Ghodke
featured_reviews.review_text: Recently attended the marriage ceremony of a kin.vExcellent ambience, great view of Hiranandani Complex from 8th floor terrace. Overall it is a good place to host  if one is willing to shell off extra bucks for a plush function.
